Reviewed for its safety invariants. Raw-byte hash and copy, no SQLite and no env loading, links refused, dated folder never overwritten, staging folder renamed only after verification; ABI-127 assert (AUD-REAUDIT-002). The unlink calls outside the self-check remove only files of the throwaway staging tree or the self-check fixtures.

Reviewed for its safety invariants. Pre-rail counts come only from an isolated git archive export; junctions are unlinked before the recursive delete; every child goes through spawnRailedChild; NAC-08 and NAC-03 re-hash at the end. Two tooling items registered from the code review: a collection failure counted as 0 in the finished --phase before mode (AUD-ROOT-009) and a bare --out writing to the committed folder (AUD-ROOT-010).
Reviewed. AST gate over vi.mock family calls; reads source only; exits 1 on a broken specifier; tested by viMockGate.test.ts.

Reviewed in full. Target resolved with the same function as db.ts. Refuses stale temp files, any sidecar, any non-zero version and any non-empty version-0 file. Builds beside the target, verifies the version, re-probes the target state, then renames. The typed-path confirmation covers replacement of an empty target. dotenv gated on VITEST.

Reviewed for its safety invariants. Reads a backup copy only and refuses a source or output inside the repo; the only file SQLite opens is a disposable copy; the report stays outside the repo. No src import, no dotenv loader. ABI-127 assert (AUD-REAUDIT-002).

Reviewed for its safety invariants. Parses the env file with dotenv's pure parse only; output is key names and yes/no/unset. D-22: only the operator runs it against the real file, and no agent did. ABI-127 assert (AUD-REAUDIT-002).

Reviewed in full. Raw-byte hashes only, never SQLite; manifest compare covers hash, size and mtime; ledger gate checks run id, expected projects and worker presence; --net-watch is honestly described as sampled. The Vitest main process is covered only by hash, listing and sampled net-watch, not the ledger (see judgment-reviews question a). Open tooling item from the code review: AUD-ROOT-011.
